title: Career Roadmap · Plumber
summary: A Plumber installs, repairs and maintains water-supply, drainage, sanitary, rainwater and related piping systems in homes, commercial buildings and industrial facilities.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Pipe installation • Sanitary fixtures • Drainage • Leak detection • Water-pressure testing • Plumbing maintenance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10; verify the current entry requirements for the selected ITI.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 can help but is not always required for ITI entry.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Building services, water supply, drainage, sanitation and basic construction drawings.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Measurement, practical problem-solving, tool safety and customer communication.

items: Building-services, site or maintenance roles, subject to employer requirements

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Safety, plumbing tools, measurement, pipe materials and basic drawings.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Installation
blocks.text: Pipe cutting, threading, joining, fittings, valves, sanitary fixtures and drainage.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Leak detection, water-pressure testing, pumps, water heaters, rainwater systems and preventive maintenance.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised site practice, practical projects, apprenticeship applications and customer-service skills.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Assemble a small water-supply line • Install a tap and washbasin model • Build a drainage demonstration • Diagnose a simulated pipe leak.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Public works maintenance, railway facilities and public-sector building maintenance where openings exist.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Plumbing contractors, construction firms, facility-management companies, hotels, hospitals and HVAC / building-services contractors.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Water supply • Drainage • Sanitary installation • Building maintenance.
Search Apprenticeship India. Availability, eligibility and stipend depend on the employer.

blocks.label: Building-services route
blocks.text: Plumber → Commercial plumbing and building maintenance specialist.

blocks.label: Self-employment route
blocks.text: Practical experience → Local plumbing service business, subject to applicable local rules.

blocks.label: Supervisory route
blocks.text: Experience + drawing and planning skills → Plumbing Supervisor / Site Supervisor.

blocks.label: Further education
blocks.text: Eligible Civil or Mechanical Engineering diploma → Broader building-services, site or maintenance roles.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Institutions to investigate
blocks.text: Government ITIs, NSTIs, recognized skill centres and state polytechnics. Confirm course availability and entry rules before applying.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Residential construction, commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, industrial facilities, water services and facility management.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Pipe measurement, cutting, joining, fitting, drainage installation, leak detection, pressure testing, drawing interpretation and safety.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Pipe cutters, wrenches, threading tools, levels, pressure gauges, drain-cleaning equipment and basic plumbing layout software.
Useful credentials

items.text: Training in water-efficient systems, pumps or building maintenance.
Local licences or registrations where applicable.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, UK, Germany and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Training routes
blocks.text: Recognized vocational colleges and technical institutes offering plumbing, building services, pipe fitting or construction trades.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Prior education or experience, language proficiency where required, practical assessments and study documentation. Admission and trade recognition vary by country.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Plumber, Plumbing Technician, Maintenance Plumber and Pipe Fitter.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Construction, residential services, commercial facilities, hospitals, hotels and industrial maintenance.
